The three dispositions are recorded and pushed. Review branch `claude/xenios-health-launch-review-20260930` now ends at `59940dc`, equal to origin. Nothing was executed and no approval was recorded on your behalf.

**Part A, SQL draft candidates at `7d027e4` (doc 45): SOURCE REVISION REQUIRED for both candidate families.** One shared P1 stops everything. All ten files assert, or depend on, a fourteen-row predecessor trigger inventory, but the migration bytes install nineteen non-internal triggers on the three fenced relations. Migration `20261001115512` adds `adp03_evidence_truncate` and `adp03_evidence_immutable` on both the requests and events tables, and `20261001062651` adds `hl12_disposition_no_truncate` on events. The candidates compare the inventory exactly, so install, precheck, postcheck, rollback and both verifiers would refuse on any database that satisfies their own gate. It is fail-closed and damages nothing, but nothing can proceed as drafted. That fourteen-row list originated in my doc 42, which the builder's contract adopted; doc 42 now carries a dated correction section owning it. Two further P2 in the intake set: the psql stop branch for a missing external hash exits 0, and an admin status update can carry evidence keys that the wrapper reads as a Quick Order marker, turning a legacy row into a permanent refusal that also blocks its own rollback. Beyond those, no source defect was found in naming, fence non-interference, least privilege, the 20-to-23-key wrapper, timestamp handling, held publication, verifier gating or the strengthened tests. Every receipt hash recomputed equal. All NOT RUN.

**Part B, held 5C design amendment (doc 46): HELD REMAINS, no body eligible for drafting.** Closed at design: guard timing, member rows, the two-sided verifier case, the named standing authority, sessions out of the trigger allowlist, the event type and server-only recipient, the exact binding helpers, the wire contract, the 23505 rule. Still open: the lock invariant is written but is falsified by the inventory release and expiry loops and by the referral privacy cleanup under the amendment's own preflight set (P1); no server configuration can hold a Health required pair today, so the standing guard still cannot be drafted (P1); the new session-row share lock is keyed on a double hash and would lock nothing silently under forced row security (P2); three relations sit under an unauthored epoch predicate, so the trigger set cannot be enumerated (P2). I accepted the held-head lock-wait distinction as design, conditional on measurement that includes writer-versus-writer serialisation. The amendment's hash is now bound in my record since no builder record binds it.

**Part C, composition tests at `5fd2e4c` (doc 47): SOURCE ACCEPT WITH LIMITS.** The sixth QO-P2-01 pin class is now authored in all three server files. One P2: all three assert the `/status` privacy-header trio on the intake document, which exceeds the pin I specified and rests on an undefined phrase in the approved scope. Until you disposition the pending `static.ts` patch `8392d243`, 17 cases are predicted red, and in the root test the trio shares one case with the pin itself. Runner compatibility of the Vite and root files is NOT PROVEN.

**Decisions that remain yours:** the `8392d243` privacy-header patch to the HARD-pinned `static.ts`, the provider-journal fixture `8396609`, the seven successor pairs and GATE-01, the Health legal pair and its configuration path, the band, and any execution reservation.
